test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A sum becomes 8,400 in 3 years and 9,600 in 5 years under simple interest. Find the principal and the annual rate (in \% to 3 decimal places).
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ SI for 2 years (5 − 3) = ₹9,600 − ₹8,400 = ₹1,200 SI for 1 year = ₹1,200 ÷ 2 = ₹600 Principal (P) = ₹8,400 − (3 × ₹600) = ₹6,600 Rate (R) = (600 ÷ 6,600) × 100 = 100 ÷ 11 ≈ 9.091% **∴ The correct answer is Principal = ₹6,600, Rate = 9.091%.**
